thesis: The speaker recounts starting his investment career at age 15 by buying P. Lard cigarettes instead of the suggested AT&T stock, which resulted in a $26 profit and cemented his lifelong desire to be in the stock market. He describes his early career path, including studying the market daily in high school, attending law school while teaching, and eventually becoming a retail broker where he achieved a major break by recommending Houston oil and gas stocks that rose from 10 to 110 due to a gas discovery in state waters.
